title: Sunday · the beach at dawn, before
logline: The Sunday before the ring week: the beach at dawn, empty, the drift log, the tide out. The strip doesn't know what Monday brings and draws the place very carefully anyway.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach at dawn in March, gray-pink, the drift log, the tide out, nobody.

image.prompt: an empty beach at March dawn in gray-pink light with a bleached drift log and the tide out, no words

panels.name: Dawn

panels.composition: Tier 2: the log, close, its grain, a place worn smooth where people sit.

image.prompt: close on a bleached drift log with a place worn smooth on top where people have sat, no words

panels.name: Log

panels.composition: Tier 3: the light coming across the wet sand. Held.

image.prompt: dawn light coming across wet sand toward a drift log, no words

panels.name: Light

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The log before the ring. Drawn carefully.
